name: antigravity-for-copilot
description: Unofficial: use Gemini and Claude models from your Google Antigravity account inside native Copilot Chat.

antigravity.reasoningEffort.markdownDescription: Thinking budget for models that support it. The budget is always capped below the model's output limit, which the gateway requires.

antigravity.showThinking.markdownDescription:
Ask the model to return its reasoning and render it as a blockquote above the answer.

VS Code does not expose a thinking part to third-party model providers (as of 1.134), so this cannot produce the collapsible **Thinking...** block that Copilot own models show - reasoning appears inline instead.

antigravity.projectId.markdownDescription: Google Cloud project id to bill requests against. Leave empty to discover it automatically. Set this if you see 403 errors mentioning a project.

antigravity.hiddenModels.description: Model ids to omit from the model picker.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Only the newest generation of each Gemini line, de-duplicated, with internal Tab/Chat/image/tiered models removed.
Every model the gateway reports, including old generations and duplicates.
antigravity.modelSelection.markdownDescription: Which discovered models to offer in the picker. Antigravity lists several generations of each line plus internal aliases; `latest` trims that to what is worth using.

antigravity.endpoint.description: Pin generation traffic to a single gateway host instead of walking the fallback chain.

antigravity.showStatusBar.description: Show remaining Antigravity quota in the status bar.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run compile
